proposed_new.trigger: One red cube on a clear support, empty parallel jaws, and current public end-effector orientation points downward. picked is the valid public LocalizationResult from localize_object("red cube", camera_name="agentview", target_frame=get_robot_state().base_frame), with at least20 points; state=get_robot_state(). Use computed x,y,grasp_z/downward in that state.base_frame. Approach from grasp_z+0.15m, descend to grasp_z, close_gripper, then lift to grasp_z+0.18m without release; move_to_pose tolerance0.015 and caps250/220/250. Entire tested open/approach/contact/close/lift costs221–239 controlticks; gripper empty during approach and carries cube during lift. No collision-aware-planner claim.
proposed_new.code:
def quantile(values, fraction):
    ordered = sorted(float(value) for value in values)
    return ordered[int((len(ordered) - 1) * fraction)]


points = picked.point_cloud.points
x = quantile((p[0] for p in points), 0.5)
y = quantile((p[1] for p in points), 0.5)
top = quantile((p[2] for p in points), 0.9)
width_x = quantile((p[0] for p in points), 0.9) - quantile((p[0] for p in points), 0.1)
width_y = quantile((p[1] for p in points), 0.9) - quantile((p[1] for p in points), 0.1)
observed_width = min(width_x, width_y)
if observed_width <= 0.0:
    raise ValueError("cube cloud has no horizontal span")
grasp_z = top - 0.65 * observed_width
downward = tuple(state.end_effector_poses["primary"].quaternion_wxyz)
